text:
ashley: heads up — spikes in dropped spans from prod tracing around 12:23 UTC, observed missing child spans for checkout flow. can someone take a look? :eyes:

mike: yep, saw traces truncating after `db.query` in multiple requests. frontend -> payments spans present, but calls to downstream inventory service not showing up.

olivia: OTEL collector logs show exporter timeouts and queue pressure. snippets: 
```
2026-03-18T12:23:07Z exporter.Write failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-18T12:23:07Z queue dropped 128 spans (queue_size=1024, max=1024)
2026-03-18T12:23:08Z exporter flushing after timeout
```

ashley: our otlp exporter config in k8s — last time it's set to flush_interval=5s and timeout=2s, queue_size=1024. if exporter takes >2s to handshake to remote, collector drops. could also be downstream egress flapping.

sre-oncall: looking at egress metrics, a few AZs had elevated tcp_rtt and transient TLS handshake errors to the vendor endpoint at 12:22-12:25. suspect combined effect: exporter slow + small timeout + queue full -> dropped spans.

mike: do we also have any proxy or LB rewrites that might be stripping `traceparent` or our custom sampling header? missing child spans usually propagation issue.

olivia: checked service proxies: there was a recent envoy tweak to header whitelist for safety (PR 4321) — it was supposed to keep `traceparent` but an edge case trimmed long headers. logs show `traceparent` present but truncated in ~0.5% of requests. separate but likely unrelated to bulk drops.

ashley: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) bump exporter timeout to 10s and queue_size to 5000, 2) route telemetry egress to alternate endpoint (regional) temporarily, 3) enable retry/backoff on exporter writes. can we patch and rollout canary?

olivia: opening a quick config PR to bump timeout/queue_size now. will create a short-lived k8s overlay and canary to 5% initially. also adding more verbose exporter metrics (exporter.duration histogram).

devex-bot: deploy queued — staging rollout started for otel-collector-config bump (PR #4892).

sre-oncall: after config bump and routing switch, queue pressure dropped and exporter latencies normalized. I still see ~0.2% truncated `traceparent` but that's not the primary cause of the large spike.

mike: can we replay missing spans? we have short-term retention on agent buffers (agent-side replay disabled in prod). if we enable replay we'd need to confirm idempotency and cost. maybe first verify with small replay test in staging.

ashley: agreed — Olivia, can you follow up with a small replay test plan + whether agents support sending buffered spans post-failure? add to the PR description.

olivia: yes — adding runbook steps: 1) bump config (merged to canary), 2) monitor exporter.queue_dropped, exporter.duration, network egress TLS errors, 3) if stable after 30m, rollout to 50% then 100%, 4) schedule replay test in staging and report.

ashley: thanks — will keep this thread updated. filing a short incident doc with root cause = exporter timeout + queue saturation + transient egress TLS errors. next action: infra to review egress resilience and add secondary telemetry endpoint routing. :memo:

sre-oncall: follow-up at 13:10 UTC — canary looked good, merged to prod. dropped spans returned to baseline. marking incident mitigated but we'll track for 24h.

olivia: PR #4892 merged. created ticket INF-1123 for long-term: telemetry re-routing, agent replay support evaluation, and header-length regression test for envoy.

mike: thanks all. small note: also add a dashboard card for exporter.queue_dropped rate (alert at >100/min) and an automated fallback to secondary endpoint if primary exporter TLS errors spike.

ashley: adding that to INF-1123. closing thread here. :white_check_mark:
